question: Among customers who purchased product ID 5 at a unit price over 25.0 in August 2012, which client segment had the highest percentage increase in gas consumption from 2012 to 2013?

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_001
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    INNER JOIN products AS p ON t.XCL_016 = p.XCL_008
    WHERE p.XCL_008 = 5
      AND t.XCL_018 / t.XCL_017 > 25.0
      AND t.XCL_011 LIKE '2012-08%'
),
segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.XCL_002 AS segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 LIKE '2012%' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS sum_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS sum_2013
    FROM qualifying_customers AS qc
    INNER JOIN customers AS c ON qc.XCL_001 = c.XCL_001
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.XCL_001 = y.XCL_019
    WHERE y.XCL_020 LIKE '2012%' OR y.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_002
)
SELECT segment
FROM segment_consumption
WHERE sum_2012 > 0
ORDER BY ((sum_2013 - sum_2012) * 100.0 / sum_2012) DESC
LIMIT 1
